contexts.text: Camels, etc. () = all things in general which belong to scientifics... Camels = general services. AC 4264.
Under Beast, see this reference.
Camel = what is scientific in general. Illustrated.
The servant took ten camels of the camels of his lord, and went () = general scientifics in the natural man... Camels = general scientifics.

The process of the conjunction of truth with good in the Lord's Divine Rational is here treated of; first the process of initiation, here, that the Lord separated those things which were from Himself in the natural man... from those which were from the maternal. Those things which were from Himself, or which were Divine, are those through which initiation took place, and are here the ten camels from the camels of his lord: hence it is that so much is here said about camels (111.) Their being so frequently mentioned is on account of the inward sense, in which they signify the general scientifics which are in the natural man, from which comes the affection of truth which is to be initiated to the affection of good in the Rational, and this according to the general way...
Their treasures upon the back of camels () = the Knowledges which are in their Natural; the back of camels = what is natural; the camels themselves = the general scientifics which are there.
He made the camels fall forward on their knees () = the holy arrangement of general scientifics. AC 3057:3.
I will give thy camels drink also () = the enlightenment thence of all scientifics in the natural man. Camels = general scientifics; thus in general, or all. AC 3094. AC 3097. AC 3102.
Camels = the natural man as to the general scientifics there...

A place for the camels () = a state for all things which would be of service thereto... Camels = things general scientifics, and services; for all things in the natural man are of no other use than to be of service to the spiritual man; wherefore also servants, camels, and donkeys, signify especially those things which are of the natural man.
And he loosed the camels () = freedom for those things which were to be of service... Camels = general scientifics, thus those things which will be of service.
And he gave straw and provender to the camels () = instruction in truths and goods.
Camels, donkeys, etc. = truths in special.
They rode upon the camels () = the Intellectual elevated above scientific natural things... Camels = general scientifics in the natural man, thus scientific natural things.
Behold, the camels coming () = to the general scientifics in the natural man.
(Rebekah) fell down from upon the camel () = the separation of (the affection of truth) from the scientifics in the natural man... Camels = the scientific things in the natural man.
Camels () = scientifics in general. AC 7503.
Camels and donkeys () = truths of good exterior and external. Camels = general scientifics of the natural man. General scientifics are the lower or more exterior truths of good...
(Jacob) lifted his sons and his women upon camels () = the elevation of these truths and affections, and their orderly arrangement in generals... Camels = general scientifics in the Natural.
(Rachel) had put them in the straw of the camel () = in scientifics...

(Jacob) halved the... camels, etc. into two camps () = preparation and arrangement of the truths and goods in the Natural to receive the good represented by Esau... Camels = exterior or general truths; thus also non-truths.
Milch camels, etc. () = general services... She-camels, etc. = those things which are of the natural man.

Their camels bearing spices, etc. () = interior natural truths. Camels, in general = those things which are of the natural man and are of service to the spiritual; and specifically, general scientifics in the natural man.
Raiment of camel's hair = the Word such as is its literal sense as to truth... for what is natural is signified by hair, and also by camels. AC 7643:end.
Camels () = scientifics in general.
Camel's hairs = scientific truths such as are there before man in the world.
Camels () = general scientifics.
Among the smaller animals (in the second Earth) they mentioned one which has its back raised like the camel.
The donkey = knowledge, and also the camel ().

As it is contrary to order (for man to introduce himself, from his Own intelligence, into the things which are of Heaven and the Church), it is said, that it is easier for a camel to pass through the opening of a needle; for a camel = the Cognitive and Scientific in general, and the opening of a needle, spiritual truth.
(The camel one of the perfect animals.)
As many things in a beetle as in a camel.
It was Societies of Spirits which thus appeared (as animals), and to which such animals correspond; as elephants and camels to those who are in general knowledge.
A troop of camels () = all who are in Knowledges of truth and good.
Camels () = scientifics which confirm.
Camel's hair = the ultimate of the natural man, which is the Sensual.
Camel's hair = the ultimates of the natural man, such as are the exterior things of the Word.

To carry their wealth upon the shoulder of donkeys, and their treasures upon the back of camels = the scientifics of the sensuous and natural man, from which they form conclusions about all things... donkeys = those things which are of the sensuous man; camels, those things which are of the natural.
Knowledges of truth are signified by camels ().
(The camel included among animals which appear in the World of Spirits.)
